notes.title: Demo Updated: 2024/6/15
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this update primarily targets bug fixes reported by our international players. Detailed update notes are as follows:

Fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed a new player tutorial block issue that only affected some international players.
[*]Fixed a multilingual configuration issue on the billboard when beverage prices are set to free.
[*]Addressed a rare issue where some players found that cats were unresponsive.
[/list]

Adjustments:
[list]
[*]Tweaked the values that influence how customers order beverages.
[*]Adjusted the difficulty levels in the "Catch a Cat" gameplay within the park.
[*]Modified the park exit UI so that cats no longer block descriptive text (this UI will be redesigned later).
[*]Altered the camera follow rules to further reduce the likelihood of motion sickness.
[*]Changed the rules for generating cat patterns.
[*]Adjusted the refresh rates and ratios for cat genders.
[/list]

Currently in development:
[list]
[*]A procedural shop building system.
[*]Level design and asset creation for a seamless city scene.
[*]Asset development for employee characters.
[/list]

We hope to introduce these new contents to you soon. To make up for the days players could not play due to the bug, we have decided to extend the demo play period by three days after the festival.

Have a great weekend, enjoy the game, and may your cats be happy!
Buffelo Games

notes.title: Demo Version Gameplay Optimization and Content Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, here's an update on our recent changes:

[list]
[*][b]New Graphics Settings[/b]
Recently, we've received a lot of feedback about the game's performance issues. Therefore, we have added some [b]graphics settings[/b] options to the main scene settings. You can now open the game and try adjusting the graphics options to find the best quality for your experience.

[*][b]Added Breeding System[/b]
Additionally, we have opened the [b]"Mating House"[/b] and some features. Now you can experience the part of cat breeding system in the Demo, including the inheritance mechanism of fur color and stats. Simply place two cats of different genders into the pink house in the northeast corner of the shop and let them bond for two days. After a night's sleep, you'll have a new kitty.

Please note that kittens cannot be used for business and cannot be placed in the love nest [strike](obviously, who could do such a thing)[/strike]. Give them enough patience and love, and they will grow into helpful and beloved big cats!

[*][b]Added Photo and Eye Adjustment[/b]
There are also new features in the cat preview scene. We have added a tab to adjust the cat's eye parameters, including color, size, pupil shape, and more. Additionally, we have added a polaroid photo frame. You can open the photo frame in the bottom right corner of the cat preview scene and press F12 to take a Steam screenshot.

[*][b]Added Non-Interactive Prompts[/b]
To enhance prompts, we have added non-interactive prompts for furniture in different shop states. We hope this feature will help you have a smoother game experience.
[/list]

These are the latest updates to our Demo version. We hope to improve your gaming experience and welcome you to join our community. If you like our game, please add us to your [b]wishlist[/b]. Thank you!

notes.title: Phase Demo Version Update + Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone, our game demo has been live for 5 days now. During this time, we have received a lot of attention, support, and feedback from our player friends. Our development team is extremely grateful.

We know that the current demo version is still far from perfect, with issues related to tutorial tasks, interactions, stability, and more. Despite these imperfections, you have still given us positive feedback and suggestions across various communities. We are very grateful. To repay your support, we have been working sleepless these past few days to fix bugs and implement the suggestions you've provided, aiming to offer you a more comfortable experience as soon as possible.

Next, we would like to report to everyone the updates made to the demo over the past 4 days as a phase summary:

[h3]Fixes[/h3] 
[list] 
[*]Locolization issue 
[*]Bug where UI was not properly reset when some furniture was moved 
[*]Bug where cats could be interrupted while eating or pooping
[*]Bug where customer interactions could be interrupted under special conditions 
[*]Adjusted UI positions and scaling for some resolutions 
[*]Bug where player's cats could disappear under certain conditions 
[*]Bug where duplicate items appeared in the store 
[*]Bug where tasks could reset after scene switching (players are still allowed to play the game without following the task flow) 
[*]Bug where cats would continuously eat can during taming 
[*]Issue with animation states getting stuck due to special operations when catching cats in the park 
[/list]

[h3]Additions[/h3] 
[list] 
[*]Added connection and highlight prompts for customers and required cats during the management phase 
[*]Re-added a one-click delete button in the main scene settings 
[*]Added trash can, which will replace the cup holder's function of returning cups 
[*]Added a express UI to display items purchased but not yet delivered 
[*]New shop cat status display on the notice board UI to show the status of cats in the store 
[*]Cats will find food on their own when hungry 
[*]Cats now have a small chance to cough up hairballs 
[*]Added the ability to transfer ingredients between cups, allowing players to adjust accidentally mixed drinks 
[/list]

[h3]Adjustments[/h3] 
[list] 
[*]Adjusted customer wait time curve 
[*]Adjusted frequency of cats pooping 
[*]Removed the feature where cats could escape 
[*]Lowered the difficulty of the coffee bean grinding interaction 
[*]Adjusted computer UI button responses 
[*]Adjusted game save points 
[*]Adjusted difficulty of the cat-catching mini-game in the park 
[*]Removed area restrictions for furniture placement in the demo version 
[*]Clarified differences between various furniture pieces in some tutorial dialogues 
[*]Adjusted prices and unlock date for some store items 
[*]Increased the influence of store ratings on customer visits 
[*]Adjusted collision of some furniture 
[*]Adjusted data structure in preparation for future new content 
[/list]

There are 41 other minor fixes and adjustments not listed here.

Next, let’s address some of the frequently asked questions we’ve seen in various communities:

[list] 
[*]Multiplayer co-op mode: 
We have always considered a party game-like multiplayer co-op mode. The original gameplay prototype of this game was presented as a multiplayer co-op. Once our planned milestones are completed and stable, we will design the co-op mode based on the content at that time. 
[*]Availability on other platforms: 
Currently, we are focusing on developing the PC version for Steam. Once the PC content development is complete, we will start planning for porting to other platforms. 
[*]Future gamepad support: 
The game will fully support controller gameplay in the future. You can already see that many of our current interaction designs are preparing for later controller operation. 
[*]Stability and graphics issues: 
The current demo version indeed has many bugs, which is one reason we debated for a long time before deciding to release the demo. On one hand, we wanted to see everyone's opinions on the gameplay early to ensure our game's direction is correct. On the other hand, we hope to discover undiscovered issues in the game with everyone's help. To ensure the future content’s health, whenever we have significant development progress, we will initiate a test and leave enough time to stabilize the version until the game is released. By then, I believe the game's stability and optimization will meet everyone's expectations. 
[/list]

These are the updates and answers to the most frequently asked questions since the demo went live. We know that posting this report does not mean our work is complete. There is still a lot of content in the plan that has not been implemented. Next, we will continue to complete our goals step by step according to the plan while stabilizing the demo version's gameplay experience. We hope that one day in the future, "Catffee Time!" will grow into a more interesting game that meets everyone's expectations with your joint witness.


Wishing all cats and humans peace and joy❤ 
BuffeloGames

notes.title: You Have a Children's Day Gift Waiting!
notes.content:
[h1]❤Happy Children's Day to all the babies out there!❤[/h1]

As the development team, we can't really send you all gifts, so instead, we're opening up the [game demo] early! We hope you have a great time playing on Children's Day!

However, please note that our current Demo only includes the [b]core management framework[/b] and [b]game loop[/b] of the game. More gameplay features will be gradually added in the subsequent development process. Due to our current limited manpower, our testing might not be thorough, so if you encounter any weird issues during your experience, please be patient. You can join our community (Discord: https://discord.gg/Nbjh9MEAFQ) to report them, and we will respond and make adjustments as quickly as possible.

[b]Here's what the Demo version includes:[/b]

[olist]
 [*]A management period limited to 8 days in-game
 [*]Store system with 40 pieces of furniture, 46 items, and 100 drink combinations
 [*]The core management loop of the game
 [*]Simple tutorial for the Demo version
 [*]Stray cat capturing gameplay with 2 park areas
 [*]Drink preparation and basic store rating
 [*]Cheats to lower the game's management difficulty (cheats are hidden at the bottom of this announcement)
 [*]Basic cat-petting interactions
[/olist]

During the Demo period, we will prioritize your feedback and improve the game experience. So once again, we warmly welcome your suggestions. Your feedback will greatly help us.

After the Demo ends, we will adjust our development plans based on the feedback and suggestions received during the test period and immediately start working on the next development milestones.

[b]Currently in development:[/b]

[olist]
 [*]More explorable city spaces and areas to find stray cats
 [*]Calendar, events, and weather systems
 [*]Shop decoration, space expansion, and back-end management
 [*]Cat growth, more personality traits and behaviors, fur patterns, and petting interactions
 [*]Features and management for when cats transform into humanoid staff members
[/olist]

[b]Planned features:[/b]

[olist]
 [*]Storylines and character settings
 [*]Local multiplayer co-op
 [*]Collection album and achievement system
 [*]Chain store plans
 [*]Staff recruitment system
[/olist]

In addition to the above core development content, we will continue to add more ingredients, furniture, decorations, and other content. We hope to provide you with a rich and enjoyable game that is fun and relaxing, allowing you to pet virtual cats in a cyber world.

Thank you once again for your support and for trying out our game. Whether you love management simulation as a store manager or adore cats as a two-legged poop scooper, we hope you have a wonderful time playing~

notes.title: [Chit-Chat] A Few Stories About the Project Initiation of "Catffee Time!"
notes.content:
Last weekend, we nervously launched a wishlist reservation on the Steam platform and received some attention and support, which is very important to us!

We have been so focused on development that we haven’t had time for promotion, and there are many interesting stories (and gossip) from our lives that we haven't shared with you. Starting today, we will be sharing various development anecdotes, logs, and cat stories. So let’s start by talking about what initially inspired this project!


First, let me briefly introduce the members of our development oversight committee and their attributes:

    [b]♀ Orange and White Cat, Airou (yes, the Airou/Felyne from MH)[/b]:
The oldest female cat in the house, always looking like a well-behaved baby with a face of grievance. She is the most understanding, has a weak stomach, and rushes when eating or drinking, which can lead to vomiting. She is obedient to people but indifferent to other cats. However, she seems to be a beauty in the cat world and is often approached by no-good cats.

    [b]♂ Blue and White Cat, Ellie (yes, Ellie from TLOU)[/b]:
The biggest fatty, a neutered old lecher, lights up at the sight of female cats and takes his chances. He is said to have as many as 30 offspring. He appears dopey but is actually quite cunning. Usually good-natured, but when he can’t stand it anymore, he will strike with heavy punches.

    [b]♂ Abyssinian Dog, Cheese[/b]:
A delicate cat that can't stand not being mischievous, timid as a mouse yet loves to provoke everywhere. He has clear yet empty eyes, with intelligence far below the average of his breed. He wants to eat everything and is nicknamed “The Scavenger.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032477/9874193c0ca387948cf90e3acc293bb2578242dd.png[/img]



These three cats have wonderful “game mechanics.” When combined, they produce unexpectedly hilarious outcomes every day:
For example, when Airou’s [Vomiting] meets Cheese’s [Scavenger], I might just go get a mop and the vomit has “disappeared” (scary to think about); when Ellie’s [Old Lecher] meets Airou’s [Beauty], a sneak attack causes Airou to lose her composure; when Cheese’s [Provoking] meets Ellie’s [Heavy Punch], you often see Cheese with a bald forehead and buttocks...

Every day, these random emergent stories create amusing moments in our lives.
In this daily tussle, I haven’t always played the role of a fair and impartial cat owner because of the differences in the cats’ personalities, genders, and ages. I always tend to pay extra attention to and protect the weaker one.

In the social environment of three adult cats, the weakest is naturally the peaceful orange and white cat, Airou.

Airou was a little stray I picked up in 2013. Because of her non-confrontational nature, she was often bullied while wandering. Therefore, she cherishes her life with us even more and is overly well-behaved. When we argue over project disagreements, she mistakenly thinks we are fighting and anxiously comes to mediate. When she accidentally causes trouble and gets scolded, she stands up and tries to jump into someone's arms to apologize face-to-face. Almost every friend who has taken care of her temporarily says she is an extraordinary little angel cat.

Now Airou is 11 years old, and her activity level has visibly decreased, and the frequency of vomiting has increased. I dread the day of parting because the passionate love we have for each other forms the bonds that tie us together.

This brings us to the original emotional motive for initiating this project: the separation between lives is an eternal pain and an unavoidable topic. All we can do is try our utmost to leave traces of our loved ones in this world. Therefore, we wanted to create a game where Airou and more cats can continue to bask in the sun in a cyber space where it is always sunny, never bullied, and full of love, and even interact more with players as humans.

However, a game needs to bring joy to everyone, and making a gloomy electronic memorial would hardly allow everyone to experience positive emotions in the game. After several rounds of discussion, we decided to create a cat café simulation game that is emotionally uplifting, full of fun gameplay, and challenging. In our vision, this game is not just a medium for nostalgic remembrance or a cyber pet interaction, but also a way for players to immerse themselves, achieve, and find joy.

Therefore, your suggestions and feedback are very important to us, as they will help us move towards the goal of [b] bringing joy to more people [/b]. We warmly welcome you to join our community at any time to offer any suggestions and help us create a meaningful and fun game together.

That’s it for today’s chit-chat. Thank you again for your support over the past few days! ❤(´∪`●)ゝ

notes.title: store page is now live!
notes.content:
Woohoo! The store page for "Catffee Time!" is now live! We are currently making the final preparations for the demo version, which should be available to everyone by the end of the month.

The current demo version offers a unique basic experience of managing a cat café and stealthily catching cats. Please note that this is just a small step in the game's developmental journey, and many features and content are still actively being developed. We are working hard to refine every aspect of the game to ensure that the full version will provide a richer and more complete gaming experience.

Upcoming features include:
[list]

[*]More cat breeds:
Introducing more unique cat breeds, each with different characteristics and needs, along with more entertaining cat animations.

[*]Expanded game area:
The entire city will be transformed into a seamless, free-to-explore space, providing a broader area for stealth cat catching and city missions.

[*]Enhanced management elements:
More types of food and mini-games for making them, store decoration expansion, employee recruitment and management, cat houses and pet treatment, seasons and weather, dynamic events to make your store more personalized and diverse.

[*]Cat interaction and development system:
A deeper and more varied experience of cat interaction and a breeding system, allowing each cat to have its unique growth path.

We sincerely invite you to provide valuable feedback while experiencing the demo. Your opinions will directly influence the improvements and development of the game. Please be understanding and patient with any issues that may arise at this stage—we promise that what we bring to you will be a more refined and engaging game.
